items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: But they had a different artist every week to emcee the show, like Douglas Fairbanks, Jr. He would emcee the show one week.

ctx.x: And then the acts would come over.

Yes, yes, that was a variety show. But they had a different artist every week to emcee the show, like Douglas Fairbanks, Jr. He would emcee the show one week. Bing Crosby, he would emcee the show. Then -- oh, I can't -- just so many people emceed the show. Then he would let me play every now and then, you know. And it was at the old Hollywood Palace show up here, where they had blackouts years ago, the El Capitan Theater, they called it the Hollywood Palace Theater. For three years, I did that. They had a…
Was this sort of the beginning of the -- you know, the kind of thing where -- like Johnny Carson has a band, which you hardly hear at all?
